summary: Complete feasibility assessment for building an AI-assisted automated arbitrage and market-inefficiency platform targeting Polymarket and Kalshi prediction markets. Covers seven dimensions: (1) Market reality and volume data for 2026, (2) API capability analysis for both platforms, (3) Competitive landscape and bot ecosystem, (4) Realistic revenue projections with math, (5) Build cost breakdown (development, infrastructure, capital), (6) Timeline and team requirements, (7) Honest assessment of whether the Antigravity system can build and operate this. Includes risk matrix, the $1M/week claim stress-test, and a phased go/no-go recommendation. All figures are source-cited from April 2026 research.
